blocks.text: Nature, Adventure & Retreat Surrounds

blocks.alt: emotional healing retreats at alive luxury wellness resorts

blocks.text: Far from the busy party zones and tourist crowds of Tulum, yet close enough to experience the beauty and culture of the Riviera Maya, the wellness resort offers a peaceful beachfront sanctuary surrounded by jungle and the Caribbean Sea. Here guests can slow down, breathe deeply and reconnect with nature while still having access to some of the most extraordinary natural and cultural experiences Mexico has to offer.
✓ Swimming in ancient crystal clear cenotes hidden within the jungle, naturally cooling, mineral rich and deeply grounding
✓ Snorkelling along the Riviera Maya coastline in turquoise Caribbean waters filled with vibrant marine life
✓ Diving the world famous Mesoamerican reef, the second largest coral reef system on earth
✓ Exploring the breathtaking Mayan ruins of Tulum perched above the Caribbean Sea
✓ Visiting sacred Mayan archaeological sites including Coba and Chichen Itza, rich with ancient wisdom and history
✓ Cycling through jungle paths and coastal roads connecting nature, local culture and the ocean
✓ Discovering secluded Caribbean beaches with powder white sand and clear turquoise water
✓ Paddleboarding and ocean swimming along calm tropical coastlines
✓ Jungle nature walks surrounded by tropical wildlife, birds and ancient trees
✓ Explore adventure activities like beach horse rides, canyoning and more
These experiences reconnect you with the earth, your intuition, your breath, your strength and your life.
And unlike machines, nature also gives you something technology never can connection to beauty, wonder, meaning and yourself.
This is why, at Alive, we do not replace human connection or natural connection with devices.
We do not plug you into machines and call it healing.
We help you build an unbreakable relationship with yourself, your future and the world you were born into a relationship many people have lost without even realising it.
This is healing that lasts. This is transformation that stays with you for life.

Wellness Therapies & Private Sessions
Private one on one therapies for physical, mental, emotional and life transformation

For those who want to go deeper, Alive offers a wide range of private wellness therapies and one-on-one sessions, delivered by highly skilled, hand-picked professionals. These sessions allow you to focus on what you need most, with personalised support that meets you where you are.

All therapies are optional and can be added to your stay at any time. Some guests choose one or two sessions. Others build a more immersive, customised wellness experience. There is no expectation to do it all. You simply choose what feels right for you.
This is where wellness becomes personal, refined and deeply supportive.
Personal Wellness Sessions Available
✓ Naturopathy & Functional Health Personalised support for energy, digestion, sleep, hormones and overall wellbeing.
✓ Integrative Medical & Preventative Health Consultations Advanced health guidance focused on optimisation, longevity and balance.
✓ Nutrition & Wellness Coaching Tailored support for nourishment, weight balance, cleansing and sustainable habits.
✓ Personal Training & Movement Therapy One-on-one strength, mobility and functional movement designed for your body and energy levels.
✓ Private Yoga & Meditation Sessions Individualised practices to support flexibility, calm, focus and mind-body connection.
✓ Breathwork & Nervous System Regulation Deep sessions to release stress, regulate the nervous system and restore inner calm.
✓ Emotional Wellbeing & Life Coaching Support for clarity, emotional balance, life direction and meaningful change.
✓ Healing & Energy Work Subtle yet powerful sessions supporting emotional release, alignment and inner restoration.
✓ Recovery & Regeneration Therapies Targeted support for rest, repair and physical renewal.
✓ Spa & Therapeutic Bodywork Massage, body treatments and restorative rituals to nurture, relax and rebalance.
Looking For Personalised Support?
One private conversation can change everything
Whether you’re feeling clear, unsure, or reaching out for someone you care about, this is a space to speak openly, be heard, and understand what’s truly possible for you
There is no pressure, no expectation, just a genuine conversation to explore where you are and what you need
The most direct way to connect is via WhatsApp. Every message is responded to personally, promptly, and in complete confidence
If you prefer, you can schedule a private call at a time that suits you and we will speak with you directly
Connect with an Alive Wellness Advisor and your booking concierge by phone or whatsapp.
